## 1. Approach

Build bottom-up in dependency order: repo hygiene, then config/app factory, DB, cross-cutting security, auth, blog features, UI, tests, docs. Step 5 writes code and tests but **does not start a server and does not commit**. Running `pytest` is deferred to Step 7 (Verification).

Amendments to `architecture.md` adopted from the design review (these supersede the architecture where they differ):

| Change | Source |
|---|---|
| Usernames match `^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{3,30}$`; identifier containing `@` is looked up as email, otherwise as username | F-01, F-08 |
| Emails lowercased before store/compare, max 254 chars, simple format pattern | F-08, F-14 |
| Password length 8-128; `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` = 64 KB; 413 handler | F-04 |
| Delete uses a server-rendered confirmation page: `GET /blog/<id>/delete`, then `POST /blog/<id>/delete` | F-03 |
| Search/sort is one GET form (search box + submit button + sort select that submits on change). No debounce | F-11 |
| New `POST /auth/keepalive` (204; 401 if expired), called by JS on form pages every 5 minutes | F-02 |
| `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE` env-driven, default false | F-05 |
| Security headers and `Cache-Control: no-store` on authenticated responses | F-06 |
| `run.py` debug via `FLASK_DEBUG`, default off, bind `127.0.0.1` | F-07 |
| Timestamps `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ` via one helper; every `ORDER BY` ends with `, id DESC`; title sort `COLLATE NOCASE` | F-09 |
| Optional `session_nonce` revocation (F-10) is **not** built; accepted as residual risk | F-10 |
| Lazy CSRF token for anonymous sessions, `hmac.compare_digest` | F-12 |
| Dummy-hash check for unknown users; logged-in users hitting login/register go to `/` | F-13 |
| Strip title/content before validation | F-14 |
| `.gitignore`, `instance/` DB, `flask init-db` plus auto-create, pinned deps, `<int:post_id>` converters | F-15 |

## 3. Key Implementation Notes

- **Blueprints:** `auth` at `/auth`, `blog` at `/` (index) and `/blog/...`. Use `<int:post_id>` so `/blog/create` never matches a post ID.
- **Routes (final):** `GET /`, `GET|POST /auth/register`, `GET|POST /auth/login`, `POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/keepalive`, `GET /blog/<int:post_id>`, `GET|POST /blog/create`, `GET|POST /blog/<int:post_id>/edit`, `GET|POST /blog/<int:post_id>/delete`.
- **Status codes:** validation failure 400; bad credentials 401; non-author 403; missing post 404; oversize body 413; bad CSRF 400.
- **Session:** cookie holds `user_id`, `last_active`, `csrf_token`. Timeout hook runs before routes, redirects to Login with a flash message (401 for keepalive). On login, clear the session first, then set values.
- **Sort map:** `date_desc` -> `updated_at DESC, id DESC`; `date_asc` -> `updated_at ASC, id ASC`; `title_asc` -> `title COLLATE NOCASE ASC, id ASC`; `title_desc` -> `title COLLATE NOCASE DESC, id DESC`.
- **Templates:** never use `|safe`; render content inside an element styled `white-space: pre-wrap`.
- **Comments and watermark:** every generated file (including `.py`, `.html`, `.css`, `.js`, `.sql`, `.txt`, `.md`) starts with the watermark in that file type's comment syntax, per `CLAUDE.md` rule 4. `requirements.txt` and `.gitignore` use `#`. JSON-style files with no comment syntax are not planned.

## 4. Test Plan (written in Step 5, run in Step 7)

All via Flask test client with a temporary SQLite DB per test.

| Area | Representative cases |
|---|---|
| Registration | Success redirects to Login; empty fields; short and over-long password; duplicate username (case-differing); duplicate email; username containing `@` rejected; invalid email |
| Login/session | Valid by username and by email; wrong password and unknown user give identical message; session persists across requests; logout clears session; expired `last_active` (monkeypatched time) redirects to Login; keepalive refreshes and returns 204; logged-in user redirected from login |
| Feed | All users' posts shown with title/author/date/snippet; snippet truncation at 150; unauthenticated redirect; default order newest first |
| Search | Title match, content match, case-insensitive, no match shows "No blogs found", `%` and `_` treated literally, combined with sort |
| Sort | All four options; tie-break stability; unknown value falls back |
| Create | Login required; blank/whitespace rejected; length limits; author set from session; redirect to detail |
| Edit | Author sees button, non-author does not; form pre-populated; `updated_at` changes and `created_at` does not; non-author GET and POST return 403 and data unchanged |
| Delete | Confirmation page shown; POST removes post; non-author 403 on GET and POST; missing post 404 |
| Security | POST without/with bad CSRF rejected; headers present; `no-store` on authenticated pages; script tags in title/content are escaped; SQL metacharacters in search and login are inert; body over 64 KB returns 413 |

Acceptance-criteria coverage target: every one of the 29 ACs has at least one test, except client-side validation attributes (US-101-AC2 client part, checked by template assertions on `required`/`minlength`).

## 5. Definition of Done (Step 5)

1. All files in the project structure exist, each with the watermark first line.
2. Every task T-01 to T-15 implemented as specified; no unlisted features added.
3. No server started, nothing committed, no secrets or database files in the working tree.
4. Code is importable (verified by a static check at most; the full test run is Step 7).

## 6. Risks and Mitigations

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Python 3.14 compatibility with pinned Flask/Werkzeug | Pin to current stable releases; confirm install in Step 7 and adjust pins if needed. |
| Watermark in `requirements.txt` or `.gitignore` | Comment syntax `#` is valid in both. |
| Watermark in `schema.sql` | Use `-- ` comment syntax. |
| Scope creep (rate limiting, pagination, session revocation) | Explicitly deferred; see design review section 5. |
